title: Document Spike Result
description: Return of the document-spike agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, the whole write-up as markdown, and the map from each recorded finding to the section that covers it

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: An open question a human should settle, or an empty string

document.description: The whole write-up as markdown, covering every recorded finding

finding_map.description: One entry per recorded finding, naming the section of the document that covers it

unit_id.description: ID of the unit whose finding this entry maps

section.description: Heading of the document section that covers the finding
